text:
customer_engineer: Customer reports svc-api.customer-acme.internal returns NXDOMAIN from inside their prod VPC after we merged hosted zones last night. They see public records fine but internal resolution fails since ~01:12 UTC. Provided dig output and said curl fails with 'Name or service not known'.

customer_engineer: dig output from their bastion:```
$ dig @10.0.0.2 svc-api.customer-acme.internal A +short
# (no output)
```

oncall_jen: looking. Do we have the target AWS account and hosted zone details? Suspect split-horizon/private-hosted-zone overlap.

customer_engineer: acct 123456789012. We merged a hosted zone from acct 210987654321. Zone name is customer-acme.internal. We thought we removed the old one but maybe something got associated incorrectly.

elaine: please run:```
aws route53 list-hosted-zones-by-name --dns-name customer-acme.internal --query 'HostedZones[*].[Id,Name,Config.PrivateZone]'
```
That should show if more than one private zone exists.

luis: output pasted:
- /hostedzone/Z1AAAA  customer-acme.internal  true
- /hostedzone/Z2BBBB  customer-acme.internal  true

samir: two private zones. Common failure: empty/placeholder private zone ended up associated to prod VPC and shadows the correct zone that contains records -> NXDOMAIN. Check VPC associations for both:```
aws route53 get-hosted-zone --id /hostedzone/Z1AAAA
aws route53 get-hosted-zone --id /hostedzone/Z2BBBB
```

luis: association summary I pulled:
- Z1AAAA associations: VPCs: vpc-0aa111 (prod us-east-1)
- Z2BBBB associations: VPCs: vpc-0bb222 (staging us-east-1), vpc-0aa111 (prod us-east-1)

samir: yep — Z2BBBB (the migration placeholder) is associated to the prod VPC too. If Z2BBBB has no records for svc-api it will return NXDOMAIN even though Z1AAAA has the correct records. Shadowing by name.

oncall_jen: quick repro on our side (using a test instance in the same VPC):```
$ dig @10.0.0.2 svc-api.customer-acme.internal A +short
# (empty)
$ dig @10.0.0.2 svc-api.customer-acme.internal SOA +short
Z2BBBB (shows serial from placeholder)
```

infra-bot: runbook match: "Private hosted zone shadowing due to overlapping zone names/associations". Recommended actions: (A) disassociate prod VPC from the empty/stale zone OR (B) populate the placeholder zone with the records. Safer immediate fix = disassociate the placeholder.

elaine: plan proposed: 1) tag /hostedzone/Z2BBBB as stale-migration, 2) disassociate vpc-0aa111 from Z2BBBB, 3) verify resolution, 4) if green, keep Z2BBBB in source acct unattached until migration complete, then delete. I'll notify customer before step 2.

customer_engineer: customer ok with immediate window. They want minimal downtime.

luis: ran disassociate:```
aws route53 disassociate-vpc-from-hosted-zone --hosted-zone-id /hostedzone/Z2BBBB --vpc VPCRegion=us-east-1,VPCId=vpc-0aa111
# response: Disassociation successful
```

samir: verify step:```
$ dig @10.0.0.2 svc-api.customer-acme.internal A +short
10.12.34.56
```

customer_engineer: customer confirms svc-api now resolves and their API requests succeed again. They reported < 2 minutes of interruption. :thumbsup:

elaine: follow-ups: add a migration checklist entry to verify no duplicate private zones are associated to the same VPC during cutover, and make a short internal note about tagging placeholder zones as "migration-placeholder" to avoid accidental association. I'll file a brief postmortem/learnings doc.

oncall_jen: opened a ticket INF-4321 to update playbook and add an automated check (list-hosted-zones-by-name -> get-hosted-zone associations) prior to cutover.

customer_engineer: thanks everyone :heart:
